name: Expressions Washi Tape, Whimsical Design, 15 Rolls (C1017-15-P5)
bestUse: Best for botanical and floral journal borders
descriptionOriginal: An assorted set of fifteen washi tape rolls in a whimsical mix of patterns, from Scotch's Expressions range.
whyWeLikeIt: One strip across a corner is often all a spread needs, and fifteen rolls leave room to find the pattern that answers your paper. The mix leans floral and botanical, in warm tones, which suits Garden Press and Tea Rose more than a plain modern set.
limitations: The set is assorted, so you cannot choose individual patterns, and a few may not suit your palette. Look at the listing images first, and test removability on a hidden spot, since washi is for decorating paper.
